search_faiss_index_with_torch: search a Faiss index using PyTorch tensors and return distances and indices
add_vectors_to_faiss_with_torch: add PyTorch tensor vectors to a Faiss index for later nearest neighbor search
train_faiss_index_with_torch: train a Faiss index using PyTorch tensor data on CPU or GPU
knn_search_with_torch_tensors: perform k-nearest neighbor search on PyTorch tensors using L2 or inner product metric
gpu_bruteforce_knn_with_torch: run GPU-accelerated brute-force kNN on PyTorch tensors with float16 or bfloat16 support
